How to Improve Customer Retention

Customer retention improves when teams understand why people stay, where they struggle, and which changes make the product more useful.

This guide explains how to measure retention and turn customer evidence into a focused improvement plan.

September 10, 2026

What is customer retention?

Customer retention measures whether people continue using a product or service over a defined period. Teams should state the cohort, interval, and activity that counts as continued use so the metric remains useful and comparable.

How do you find retention problems?

Start by comparing cohorts over the same time interval. Look for the point where engagement changes, then review support conversations and product behavior to understand what customers were trying to accomplish.

How can a team improve retention?

Choose one evidenced friction point, make a focused change, and compare the result with a suitable baseline. Keep the cohort and measurement window consistent, and share what the team learned.

  1. Define the customer cohort.
  2. Find a meaningful drop-off point.
  3. Test one useful improvement.
